WITH p AS (SELECT MIN(calendar_date) mn, MAX(calendar_date) mx FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=4),
l AS (SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f, p WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN p.mn AND p.mx)
SELECT (SELECT mn FROM p) mn, (SELECT mx FROM p) mx, COUNT(*) n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids,
 COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) keys, MIN(sale_date) minsale, MAX(sale_date) maxsale,
 COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, MIN(etl_loaded_at) l1, MAX(etl_loaded_at) l2
FROM l

WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.*, s.store_id, cs.format, p.category
 FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30')
SELECT format,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag AND category<>'ZZ Test' AND store_id<900 THEN receipt_id END) receipts,
 SUM(CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag AND category<>'ZZ Test' AND store_id<900 THEN net_amount END) net,
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag AND category<>'ZZ Test' AND store_id<900 THEN net_amount END)/COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag AND category<>'ZZ Test' AND store_id<900 THEN receipt_id END),2) atv,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN receipt_id END) staff_receipts,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN receipt_id END) test_receipts,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN category<>'ZZ Test' AND NOT staff_purchase_flag AND store_id<900 AND channel_code='WB' THEN receipt_id END) wb_in_stores,
 SUM(CASE WHEN net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos_lines,
 COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) stores,
 SUM(CASE WHEN store_id<900 AND category<>'ZZ Test' THEN net_amount END) net_all_incl_staff
FROM l GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH l AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, SUM(f.net_amount) net, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) nsbr, SUM(receipts) rc FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT l.store_id, l.net, r.nsbr, ROUND(l.net-r.nsbr,2) diff, l.rc, r.rc rpt_rc FROM l FULL JOIN r USING(store_id) WHERE r.nsbr IS NULL OR l.net IS NULL OR ABS(l.net-r.nsbr)>0.5 OR l.rc<>r.rc ORDER BY 1
